h1: Variants and options, set up so shoppers choose right
overview: Shoppers leave when sizes, colors or bundles confuse them. We set up your options in a clear order, give each variant its own price, SKU, stock and image, and make sure sold-out choices are labeled properly. Where your store supports it, we build bundles and add-ons so a shopper can pick a set in one step. Then we test the choices on a phone and a computer.

faq: How many variants can my store handle?
Platforms set their own limits on options and variants. We check yours first and suggest a simpler structure if a product has too many combinations, for example by splitting one product into two.
Can you set up bundles that discount automatically?
We can set up bundle products and, where your platform supports it, a simple discount rule. Advanced bundle logic may need a paid app, billed by the app maker. We tell you before we install anything.
Will changing variants affect my past orders?
Past orders keep the details they were placed with. For live products we avoid deleting variants that have sales, and edit them instead. We also back up the product data in a sheet first.
Can you merge separate listings into one product?
Yes. We combine listings such as a shirt sold as five separate products into one product with options, keep the best images and set redirects from the old pages. You approve the merge plan first.
